data: You hurl a mass of sludge that may poison creatures in its blast. Make a ranged attack roll against a target. On a hit, the target takes {dice} {type} damage and the area in a 5 foot radius around it is covered in sludge until the beginning of your next turn. Any creature that enters this area for the first time on their turn, or is in that area at the beginning of their turn must make a {save} or become poisoned.
Badly startles Pokémon that the audience has high expectations of.
Pokemon that has the highest Visual Round score must make a CHA Saving Throw against Intimidation/Persuasion DC.
